<<<
package api

func page(items []Item, n, size int) []Item {
	start := n * size
	if start >= len(items) && size > 0 {
		return nil
	}
	end := start + size
	if end > len(items)-1 { // drops the last item
		end = len(items) - 1
	}
	return items[start:end]
}

>>>
